title: Foam logo mockup prompt for Adobe Firefly / Nano Banana
author: Amira Zairi (@azed_ai)
prompt_text: Create a premium foam logo mockup using the provided logo shape or brand mark. Rebuild the logo entirely from thick white soap foam and dense bubbly lather on a glossy black wet stone surface. Preserve the original logo silhouette and readable proportions while replacing the material with realistic foam texture, micro bubbles, wet droplets, soft rounded edges, subtle translucency, and tactile volume. Use a close-up top-down advertising product shot, high contrast black-and-white palette, clean studio reflections, sharp macro detail, square composition, no extra text, no watermark.
